FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

ModelChoice.description: Which model to read: the current one, or the newest published.

oneOf.description:
The session's current revision's model, rebuilt if it isn't yet: what an agent that
just edited reads.

The newest model published, which may be an older revision's, read at once: what a
UI reads while a rebuild runs.

request.description: `angle`'s request: the angle between two elements, each a straight edge or a planar face.

elements.description: The two elements, by name: each a straight edge or a planar face.

feature.description: The feature whose solid to find them in, or null for every body.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

request.title: AngleRequest

Angle.description: An angle in degrees: a number, to at most 9 decimals (nanodegrees). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

angle.description:
In degrees. Two planar faces: the angle of the wedge both outward normals point into,
0 to 180 (a 30° wedge reads 30; parallel faces 0 facing each other, 180 facing the
same way). Two straight edges sharing one vertex: the angle at it, 0 to 180. Other
straight edges, or a straight edge and a planar face: 0 to 90 between their lines and
planes.

vertex.description: For two straight edges sharing one vertex, the vertex, by name; null otherwise.
